How to use

  • Click a time-window pill to change the return window for the chart and both tables.
  • Hover a point for the full fund card — Fund Score, spider rating, and 1Y comparison vs its sub-category.
  • Drag = pan · mouse wheel = zoom at cursor · double-click or Reset = back to full view.
  • Filters cascade (Main → Sub) and combine with AND; Find matches name / code / AMC, multiple words = OR.
  • Dashed lines mark the median SD, median return, and 0% return of the current selection.
Methodology & data freshness
Fund Score (v3): Composite 0–100 score from SEC factsheet stats ranked within each AIMC sub-category — 40% 1Y return, 35% Sharpe, 25% max drawdown (less negative = better). Grades: A+ ≥90, A ≥80, B+ ≥70, B ≥60, C ≥40, D <40. Bubble colour follows score tier. Funds launched <1Y ago carry a young fund badge — their 1Y return is an implied figure (annualised since-inception, marked †) and their Sharpe / drawdown come from since-inception history. Young funds are ranked against the mature peers' actual 1Y stats for their own comparison only — they are excluded from every peer distribution and category average, so they never affect other funds' percentiles. Treat their rankings as provisional. Funds priced weekly/monthly (e.g. PE vehicles) get risk stats from their own NAV at native cadence (×√52 / ×√12), flagged on the card and likewise excluded from peer baselines.
Universe: 3,307 funds (SEC Thailand Open API). Funds without their own 1-Yr StdDev fall back to (1) another share class of the same master fund (hollow amber rim), or (2) the category median (tagged cat·proxy).
NAV / return freshness: 1,462 funds priced 2026-08-14 · 1,326 on 2026-08-17 · 392 on 2026-08-13 · most recent 2026-08-17. Hover or pin any fund to see its own NAV date.
Source: Thailand SEC Open Data API (api.sec.or.th). Stats computed locally from daily NAV history.
Dividend treatment: SEC publishes raw NAV; dividend classes are converted to Total Return where possible. Funds tagged TR proxy use the sister Acc class. Funds tagged TR adjusted use SEC FundDailyInfo dividend history to reinvest cash distributions. Funds still tagged price-only have no usable dividend data yet, so returns exclude paid distributions.
Filled = own 1Y StdDev Amber rim = StdDev via proxy · Bubble size ∝ AUM · colour = Fund Score tier · Hover a point for the full fund card
